During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] were forced to '''evacuate''' their base on [[Alis Point]]. During the evacuation, Alliance [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]] held off three [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] while an unarmed [[Transport/Legends|transport]] carrying the base personnel fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Senesca considered the engagement one of his proudest moments.<ref name="MTS" />
